thread:
alex: starting overnight warmup for APAC standby slice — quick check: vendor reported A100s warming, telemetry showing HK ingest. anyone seeing lag in metrics?

maria: i saw a tiny delay around 00:15 UTC, looked transient. did vendor finish the kernel upgrade on those racks?

vendor-api: vendor-api: warmup job started for slice S-APAC-22. ETA ~12m. job link: https://vendor.example/jobs/123 (logs + progress)

jin: if warmup completes, can we run the smoke that exercises kv-cache prefixes? cc @alex

alex: yes. plan: 00:35 run smoke script, 00:45 small perf sweep. smoke runner PR is merged: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/456
curl -s https://vendor.example/api/status | jq .slice_status

samir: quick quota check — we have 24 A100s reserved for S-APAC-22; sweep wants 28. can we borrow 4 from standby pool?

lisa: finance will flag burst cost if we borrow. can we run a reduced sweep (20% load) instead? also ops wants borrow requests via tenant-alloc ticketing flow.

alex: ok will shorten to 20%. jin, can you change sweep target to 20% and update the PR? i'll open tenant-alloc ticket in case we need standby borrow.

jin: on it. pushed change to PR #456: set env SWEEP_PCT=20. deploying to canary now. watching logs: `kubectl logs -f pod/smoke-runner`

maria: telemetry note: aurelia-ingest showed a retry spike at 00:22 but recovered by 00:24, marking flaky for now.

alex: thanks. if warmup finishes and telemetry is clean we proceed; otherwise abort and ask vendor to rollback kernel. vendor ETA?

vendor-api: vendor-api: warmup complete for S-APAC-22, duration 10m, health=nominal, job id=123.

samir: great — go ahead with 20% sweep. i'll hold on borrowing standby until we see memory pressure.

jin: starting sweep now. heads-up: will hit model cache + KV for ~3k steps, watching tail-latency.

alex: if p99 > 150ms abort and notify #eng-oncall.

jin: saw a p99 blip to 210ms at iteration 45 (egress blip), restarted runner, p99 back to ~95ms.

maria: :thumbsup: nice recovery. please paste the short runner logs for the run.

jin: logs (tail):
[00:35:42] smoke-runner: warmup hit key-prefix /kv/prefix/abc, cache rate 98%
[00:36:10] smoke-runner: iter 45 p99=210ms (network egress spike)
[00:36:12] smoke-runner: restarting worker -> exit 137; respawned
[00:36:40] smoke-runner: iter 46 p99=95ms, tx OK
[00:37:50] smoke-runner: sweep complete, errors=0, avg p50=30ms p99=95ms

alex: filing a quick post-run note for release. we'll keep slice online and monitor for 2 hours. thanks everyone.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: no alerts fired during sweep window.
